text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: After traveling through the real world, Fio returns to the world of Astrum. When her consciousness awakens once again...
text_block_list.orig_text:
現実世界の旅を経て、
フィオはアストルムの世界へと帰還する。
その意識が、
再び目覚めると──

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Mmm...

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: A familiar scenery, a nostalgic atmosphere...
text_block_list.orig_text:
見覚えのある風景、
懐かしい
空気──

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: ...I'm back, aren't I?
text_block_list.orig_text:
──戻ってきたのね、
あたし。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Wait, why?! I'm back in my original form!
text_block_list.orig_text:
って、
なんでよ！
あたし、
元の姿じゃないの！

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Was this Akira's doing? I wonder if she made some kind of mistake.
text_block_list.orig_text:
晶の仕業？
なんか失敗でもしたのかしら。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Geez, seriously...
text_block_list.orig_text: まったくもう……

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: That's my line!
text_block_list.orig_text: それあたしの！

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Or rather, is that really the first thing you want to say to me after all that hard work I went through to return home!? You just wanted to say that line once, didn't you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
っていうか
散々苦労して帰ってきたあたしに
最初に言うセリフがそれ！？
あんたそれ一回言ってみたかっただけでしょ！

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Normally, in a situation like this one you'd...
text_block_list.orig_text: 普通こういう時はさ──

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.orig_text: たっ……

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: I'M HOMEEEEEE~!
text_block_list.orig_text: ただいま～～～～～っ！

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: I WAS SCARED～! I was really scared!
text_block_list.orig_text:
怖かった～！
ほんっと怖かったんだから！

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: It was my very first time inside of a human's body, and the Interpol just up and chased me around! I had no idea what to do!
text_block_list.orig_text:
人間の体なんて初めてだったし、
国際警察には追われるし、
何をすればいいのかも分からないし！

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: ...And YOU weren't there with me either!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──あんたもいないし！

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: I was scared... really scared...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
本当に……
怖かった……！

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Even if it was just your voice, I was so glad to know you were there by my side...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
声だけでも傍にいてくれて、
本当に助かったわ……！

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: ...! Of course I have. I'm going to become a full-fledged guide fairy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
っ……！
あったりまえよ。
あたしは
一人前の
ガイド妖精になるんだから。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: This much is no problem at all♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
この程度の出来事、
全然
問題ないわっ♪

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: That said... praise me a little more.
text_block_list.orig_text:
けど……
もう少し、
褒めて。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Until I say it's fine.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あたしが
いいって言うまで。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: ...Phew. I've finally calmed down.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
ふぅ。
ようやく落ち着いた。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: I'll borrow your shoulder for a bit. Not that I need to ask for your permission, though.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっと
肩借りるわよ。
許可なんていらないけど。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I knew it. This is where I truly belong. I'm your guide fairy, after all.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
やっぱり
ここがあたしの居場所だわ。
あたしはあんたの
ガイド妖精だもの。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Yeah... It is so reassuring. Just having him next to me...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ……
安心する。
こいつが隣にいるだけで……

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: If only you had been "over there" with me, {0}, I'm sure we would have had more fun.
text_block_list.orig_text:
『向こう』でも、
{0}がいてくれたら。
きっと、
もっと
楽しめたのよね。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: That sounds just like a dream... a bedtime story...
text_block_list.orig_text:
夢みたいな……
話だけどさ……

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Maybe it's because I pushed myself too hard... I'm a bit... sleepy...
text_block_list.orig_text:
色々無理したから、
かしら……
ちょっと……
眠くて……

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Just a little longer, like this...
text_block_list.orig_text:
もうちょっとだけ、
このまま──

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Fio slowly fell asleep atop {0}'s shoulder.
text_block_list.orig_text:
フィオは{0}の肩の上で、
ゆっくりと眠りへと落ちていく。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: ...Once more, in a new dream.
text_block_list.orig_text: ──そして再び夢を見る。

text_block_list.text: ...Wait a minute.
text_block_list.orig_text: ──待ちなさいよ。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Great work out there.
text_block_list.orig_text: お疲れさま。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: ...Let's go home together.
text_block_list.orig_text: 一緒に帰りましょ。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: What's wrong with you? Staring at me so aimlessly and spacing out.
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうしたのよ？
こっち見て、
ボーッとしちゃってさ。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: What～? Are you captivated by me, perchance～?
text_block_list.orig_text:
な～に～？
あたしに見とれちゃってたわけ～？

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: As if that'd ever be the case. You must be used to seeing me by now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
な～んて、
そんなわけないか。
あんたは見慣れてるもんね。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Oh yeah, let's take a little detour on the way home today!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだ、
今日はちょっと寄り道して帰りましょ！

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: I don't remember asking for an answer! Come on, shut up and follow me♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
はいもいいえもなしっ！
ほら、
黙ってあたしについてきなさいっ♪

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Ah, this stuffed animal is so cute! Maybe you should buy it for me as a present~...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
このぬいぐるみかわいい！
あたしに
プレゼントとか──

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Sweets that you can eat after school truly are the best~...
text_block_list.orig_text:
放課後に寄り道して
食べるお菓子って
最高よね──

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Hey, why don't we play a little game? You're welcome to lose on purpose~...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねぇ、
ちょっと対戦しない？
接待プレイも歓迎よっ──

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Don't waste too much money on this. I'll have to stop you~...
text_block_list.orig_text:
無駄遣いはほどほどにね。
あたしは止めたからね──

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: The wind here feels so nice...♪ Let's sit on the bench and relax~...
text_block_list.orig_text:
風が気持ちいい……♪
ベンチに座って、
のんびりしましょ──

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Geez, you haven't even prepared a single bouquet while having all those flowers around. You still have a long way to go~...
text_block_list.orig_text:
もうっ、
花束の一つも用意してないなんて、
あんたもまだまだね──

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: ...Phew♪ We played a lot♪ How was it? My guided tour.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──ふぅっ♪　
遊んだ遊んだ♪
どうだった？　
あたしの案内は。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Heheh, of course it is♪ Because I'm your...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふんっ、
当然よ♪
だってあたしはあんたの──

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Ehehe♪
text_block_list.orig_text: ふふっ♪

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Well then, it's about time we returned home.
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあ、
そろそろ帰りましょっか。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Welcome home!
text_block_list.orig_text: おかえりー

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: What's with that startled look on your face?
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうしたのよ、
そんなビックリした顔して。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Do you find it strange that I'm here?
text_block_list.orig_text: あたしがここにいるのが不思議？

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: ...Perish the thought.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……何言ってるのよ。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: I'm your guide fairy, after all.
text_block_list.orig_text: あたしはあんたのガイド妖精なんだから。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: No matter where, we'll always be together♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
どこだって、
ずっと一緒に決まってるでしょ♪

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: That dream was a very happy one filled with Fio's wishes.
text_block_list.orig_text:
その夢は、
フィオの願いが詰まった、
とても幸せな夢だった。
